summary: Borr Drilling via subsidiaries launched a $1.6B senior secured notes offering due 2032/2034. Proceeds along with cash will repurchase its 10.000% 2028 notes and up to $447.3M of its 10.375% 2030 notes. The notes are guaranteed by the company and subsidiaries, secured on a senior basis by most rigs and assets. A concurrent tender offer is subject to pricing and settlement of this offering. This is a refinancing/liability management transaction essentially returning capital to noteholders via repurchase. Watch for tender offer acceptance levels and final pricing spreads. From a risk-arb lens, monitor noteholder participation and potential proration.
